notes: 02: metadata collects title/description/favicon only; no preview image (og:image never parsed). 03: title editable before (form) and after (PATCH), but description is never user-editable. 04: only title can be edited (PATCH updateTitle); url/description/tags/note editing not implemented. 12: search covers title/description/url but not note (no note field exists). 22: list is fixed newest-first by createdAt; no user-selectable sort key (title etc.) or sort control. 14: no #tag search syntax. 15: no AND/OR/NOT/parenthesis operators. 16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. 17-19: no unread/read-later flag, no unread view, no mark-as-read. 20-21: no multi-select or bulk actions, filtered or otherwise. 23: no note/markdown field or rendering. 24: no local HTML snapshot and no PDF rule. 25: no Internet Archive integration. 26-28: no archive flag, no archive/delete distinction, no archived view. 29: no bundles (saved search+tags). 30-31: no Netscape HTML import/export. 32: no user settings (default sort, displayed items, font size).
